# Graph-Guided Retrieval for Scientific Agents

## Abstract

We study scientific agents that combine full-text evidence, graph retrieval, and adaptive navigation.

## Introduction

Scientific workflows need provenance-preserving retrieval over paper text. A stable ingestion boundary should keep the original source path, extraction mode, warnings, and parser metadata.

## Method

The agent builds a PageIndex from deterministic local markdown before any network or PDF extraction is attempted.

## Conclusion

Local markdown ingestion provides a reliable contract for downstream evidence paths.
